integChoice.reason: Cheapest integ exercising the module's core resources (Namespace + Service + Instance) with minimal counts: one PublicDnsNamespace, one Service (A record, dnsTtl, HTTPS health check), one IpInstance — the canonical instance type. No VPC and no ELB/ALB (unlike the private-dns integ, which drags in a full VPC + ApplicationLoadBalancer). Unambiguously provider-valid: health_check_config is only valid on public DNS namespaces, so no tofu-validate risk (the http-namespace integ attaches a health check to an HTTP-namespace service and adds a 2nd service + NonIpInstance, more resources and a riskier shape). Exercises DnsConfig + HealthCheckConfig + IpInstance in one small stack.

layoutNotes: NAMESPACE: edge is validated and kept — no filename or exported-class collisions exist against the current edge barrel (certificate-base, certificate, distribution, dns-alias-record-targets, dns-record, dns-zone, function, key-value-store, origin, response-headers-policy). DIRECTORY + EXPORT STRATEGY: place all 11 CloudMap files in a `cloudmap` SUBDIRECTORY (src/aws/edge/cloudmap/, with private/utils.ts) and wire it via a namespaced re-export `export * as cloudmap from "./cloudmap";` in src/aws/edge/index.ts — the established compute/notify submodule pattern (conventions.md). Reason: upstream filenames service.ts / instance.ts / namespace.ts are extremely generic and would pollute the flat edge/ dir and invite future collisions; the subdir isolates them, keeps upstream filenames verbatim, and namespaces the API as edge.cloudmap.Service / edge.cloudmap.PublicDnsNamespace / etc. (No collision forces a rename; the subdir is a hygiene choice.) COLLISION RESOLUTION: none required. ALREADY-PORTED REUSE: compute.IVpc (src/aws/compute/vpc.ts) for PrivateDnsNamespace and compute.ILoadBalancerV2 + loadBalancerDnsName (src/aws/compute/lb-shared/base-load-balancer.ts) for Service.registerLoadBalancer — import `from "../../compute"`. Base classes AwsConstructBase / AwsConstructProps / AwsStack / IAwsConstruct from "../../"; ValidationError from "../../../errors". CRITICAL PATH-DEPTH NOTE: because cloudmap/ is one level deeper than the edge/ exemplars, every cross-cutting import gains one `../` vs dns-zone.ts/topic.ts (dns-zone: "../", "../compute", "../../errors"  ->  cloudmap: "../../", "../../compute", "../../../errors"). DO NOT reuse edge/dns-zone.ts for PrivateDnsNamespace: the provider has a first-class aws_service_discovery_private_dns_namespace that creates the Route53 private zone internally — no route53 composition. PROVIDER MAPPING (cdktn dirs are service-discovery-*): CfnHttpNamespace->serviceDiscoveryHttpNamespace.ServiceDiscoveryHttpNamespace, CfnPublicDnsNamespace->serviceDiscoveryPublicDnsNamespace.ServiceDiscoveryPublicDnsNamespace, CfnPrivateDnsNamespace->serviceDiscoveryPrivateDnsNamespace.ServiceDiscoveryPrivateDnsNamespace, CfnService->serviceDiscoveryService.ServiceDiscoveryService, CfnInstance->serviceDiscoveryInstance.ServiceDiscoveryInstance. Provider instance config uses `attributes` (not CFN's instanceAttributes). Data sources data-aws-service-discovery-{service,http-namespace,dns-namespace} exist but are NOT needed — keep upstream's attribute-based fromXxxAttributes static factories. `Names` UTILITY: cdktn does NOT export `Names` (verified) — the repo has no Names helper either; replace upstream `Names.uniqueId(this)` (instance.ts uniqueInstanceId, alias-target-instance.ts) with `this.stack.uniqueResourceName(this, { maxLength: 64 })` (or node.addr), preserving the trim-to-64 behavior; converters verify the helper signature against topic.ts. PHYSICAL NAMING (INVARIANT #1): aws_service_discovery_service.name is REQUIRED with NO name_prefix while CDK Service name is optional -> default `props.name ?? this.stack.uniqueResourceName(this)` (exact form). By contrast the three namespace `name`s are user-REQUIRED exact identifiers/DNS domains (foobar.com) and MUST pass through verbatim (mirrors dns-zone.ts zoneName passthrough) — this is the semantically-exact case, not the collision-prone generated-name case; document the tension inline. CIRCULAR DEPENDENCY: service.ts <-> the four instance subclasses (Service.register* instantiate them; they type-import IService/DnsRecordType/RoutingPolicy/DiscoveryType from service.ts). Ordering puts service (order 2) before the subclasses (order 4); converters must co-read the cycle. CONVERSION ORDER (leaves first; same-order files never import each other): 1 namespace; 2 service; 3 instance + private/utils (independent of each other); 4 the four instance subclasses (independent of each other); 5 the three concrete namespaces (independent of each other); 6 barrels. BARREL WIRING ASSIGNMENT: the order-6 index.ts converter owns BOTH cloudmap/index.ts (re-export the 10 modules, exclude servicediscovery.generated) AND the edit to edge/index.ts adding the `export * as cloudmap` line. CANNED METRICS: none — no *-canned-metrics.generated.js in the built aws-cdk-lib bundle and the L2 exposes no metricXxx() methods, so gen-canned-metrics.mjs is NOT run. TESTS live under test/aws/edge/cloudmap/ (namespace/service/instance .test.ts); the 4 integ.*.lit.ts files in upstream test/ are integ snapshots, not jest units — excluded from testFiles. All src/test files get the mandatory v2.233.0 provenance header (barrels + private/* + generated excepted).
